scope.description: All eighteen approved EC-12000 scenarios are accounted for (TS-020 added at Gate 2 v2, split out of TS-016). Ten were executed against qa5 and passed, including TS-007 through TS-010 and TS-016, which were re-verified live this round after BLOCKER-EC-12000-004 was resolved: the recorded Media Type is observable in the DOCUMENT history's Submitted Paper Out event, and in the Verify Paper Out modal's package download for an Authorized fixture. Eight are recorded BLOCKED with the exact blocker that prevents them: they have step definitions that throw by design, so they are never reported as passing and never silently skipped.

scenarios.gherkinScenario: The Paper Out Request modal shows the Media Type section with Print to Paper selected by default
Selecting Save as Electronic File and completing required fields opens a checkbox-gated acknowledgement modal
Confirming the acknowledgement modal closes both modals and creates the Work Queue approval item
Cancelling the acknowledgement modal leaves the Paper Out Request modal open with no Work Queue item created
UI Print to Paper at transaction level determines Media Type Paper
UI Print to Paper at document level determines Media Type Paper
UI Save as Electronic File at transaction level determines Media Type Electronic
UI Save as Electronic File at document level determines Media Type Electronic
API mediaType=PrintToPaper at transaction level determines Media Type Paper
scenarios.blockerReason: eoRequestExport's endpoint URL, HTTP method and response shape remain unverified. It is confirmed to live entirely outside the ssweb browser app Playwright MCP drives (Postman-only in dev usage, absent from reports/validation/ecore-api-discovery.json), so its contract cannot be captured through browser exploration. A human must supply the integration endpoint (base URL/credentials) or an existing WSDL/integration-guide reference. See reports/validation/TP-EC-12000-001-api-validation.json. These five scenarios are also marked automationCandidate: false in the approved test plan, so automating them additionally requires a Gate 2 plan revision.

scenarios.gherkinScenario: Media Type is recorded on the Submitted Paper Out event, not the Authorized one, and appears in the downloaded activity history report
Historical Paper Out records are not retroactively updated with Media Type
scenarios.blockerReason: The recorded Media Type is not observable anywhere in qa5. A real transaction-level Paper Out was driven end to end against "test collection" on 2026-09-14 (submitted, then cancelled), and "Media Type" appeared on neither the Workspace, the Work Queue nor the transaction History dialog - the History recorded no Paper Out event at all. Two questions need a human before these steps can assert anything: (1) where is Media Type meant to surface in 26.3, and (2) is the recording change actually deployed to qa5? The remaining candidates (package cover page, activity history report) are reachable only via Verify, which permanently destroys vault documents, so they were not probed. See features/generated/paper-out-export/TP-EC-12000-001-automation-design.md and reports/validation/TP-EC-12000-001-browser-validation.json. (BLOCKER-EC-12000-001, the earlier "no qualifying fixture" gap, is RESOLVED: "test collection" qualifies and now backs TS-EC-12000-003.)

scenarios.blockerReason: Marked MANUAL_ONLY by the approved test plan: visual border alignment is not a reliable Playwright assertion target. A human reviewer must confirm it visually.
